$comment: Typical one-off costs of buying a home, used by the up-front costs calculator. Market practice, not regulation: every figure is a starting estimate the user can change, and each is flagged for verification against current quotes.

lawyerFeeRate.label: שכר טרחת עורך דין (לפני מע"מ)
lawyerFeeRate.note: Typical 0.5%–1% of the price plus VAT for a purchase from a private seller; the fee is negotiable and there is no statutory rate. We use the low end as a floor.

brokerFeeRate.label: עמלת תיווך (לפני מע"מ)
brokerFeeRate.note: Customary 2% of the price plus VAT when a broker is used; negotiable, and zero when buying directly from a developer or a private seller without a broker.

vatRate.label: מע"מ
vatRate.note: Standard VAT rate in Israel since 1 January 2025, applied to lawyer and broker fees.
